## Findings to address, severity order

1. ⚠️ **DEF-370** — `npm run typecheck` (root `tsc --noEmit`) is red: 8 errors, all in
   `apps/erp/src/components/money/MoneyLines.tsx` (T-266), because root `tsconfig.json`'s generic
   `"@shareat/domain/*": ["./packages/domain/src/*"]` path entry shadows the domain package's own
   declared subpath exports (`./money-lines`, `./attendance/fingerprint` in
   `packages/domain/package.json`). `apps/erp/tsconfig.json` already carries the correct fix —
   explicit entries for both subpaths. **Fix**: add the same two lines to the root
   `tsconfig.json`'s `paths`, then re-run `npm run typecheck` clean. This is a two-line, low-risk
   fix; it just couldn't be auto-applied this run because the baseline was already red (auto-fix
   is skipped entirely under a red baseline, per the skill's own rule) — a config-only fix on top
   of a red baseline is exactly the "not provably green" case that rule exists to avoid, since the
   baseline itself needed the fix to prove anything against.
